title: CIT-U’s Jude Bernard Miñoza tops Civil Engineer Boards, becomes University’s 97th first placer
summary: Years of discipline, resilience, and support from his mentors and family have paid off for Jude Bernard Villarba Miñoza, a ‘Teknoy’ alumnus of the Cebu Institute of Technology–University…

blocks.text: Years of discipline, resilience, and support from his mentors and family have paid off for Jude Bernard Villarba Miñoza, a ‘Teknoy’ alumnus of the Cebu Institute of Technology–University (CIT-U) who emerged as the No. 1 examinee nationwide in the September 2026 Civil Engineer Licensure Examination. Miñoza earned an outstanding 93.95% rating, topping a field of 17,062 examinees nationwide. Only 6,337 passed the examination, giving the country a passing rate of 37.14%. His achievement also marked a historic milestone for CIT-U: Miñoza is the university’s 97th board exam first placer, adding to the institution’s long-standing record of producing top-performing professionals.
